levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن سعيد بن عقدة الكوفي

notes: «من كتابه سنة ثلاث وسبعين ومائتين» is a remark on the copy, not a name (rule 1)
the Prophet ends the chain (rule 12); the scene after his words (عبد الله بن زيد, Abu Ja'far's reply) is not a link (rule 6)
the Imam written after «عن» stays narrator (owner ruling 2)
